name: Propeller Plane
summary: Small single-engine high-wing propeller plane in side view; the propeller spins in the fly animation. For sky scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom of the wheels stands on y; it flies in the air above the ground

params.name: s
params.note: scale: about 520 px wide and 350 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: fly = gentle hover and the propeller spins

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the plane faces left

author: krakujs
